observations: Orange three-seater sofa with vertical channel tufting on the backrest.
Yellow wingback armchair with diamond tufting.
Lime green rectangular ottoman with diamond tufting.
White rectangular center table with a marble-patterned top and a lower shelf.
The lighting in the photos is colored (blue/orange), which may mask stains or discoloration.
A watermark 'DAMMY DAMMY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: Photos are taken in low, colored light which hides surface wear and fabric condition.
Photos 0, 1, and 2 show a sofa, an armchair, and an ottoman.
Photo 2 shows a marble pattern, but it is unverifiable remotely if it is genuine stone or a laminate/printed glass top.

risks.risk: Structural damage or sagging in the sofa frame.
risks.proof: A video of a person sitting on different sections of the sofa to test firmness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a weakened or sagging frame

risks.risk: Hidden stains, odors, or fabric thinning masked by colored lighting.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos taken in natural daylight without filters.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring professional deep cleaning and having visible wear

risks.risk: Table top is cheap laminate or fragile glass rather than marble.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the edge of the table top to see the material thickness and grain.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a laminate-topped MDF table

proof_requests: Clear photos of all items in natural daylight.
Close-up photo of the edge of the center table top.
Video showing the underside/legs of the sofa and chairs.
Close-up photos of the armrests and seat cushions to check for fabric wear.
response.reason: The items are clearly identified by type. While the condition and material of the table are unverified, they can be priced at the worst-case 'used' condition for a standard upholstered set and laminate table.
